allow: Renaming or moving files and directories (mv, git mv) and removing git-tracked files (git rm) under /home/iamnande/src.

Committing in the senzu state repo (~/src/iamnande/senzu): git commit -m or -F with explicit paths under beans/, memory/, references/, weeks/ or docs/. claude-guard blocks every other form, path and override.
hard_deny: Deleting a git branch, local or remote: git branch -d/-D, git push --delete or :ref, git update-ref -d, gh pr merge --delete-branch, or the GitHub API.
Pushing to any remote: git push, git subtree push, git lfs push, send-pack, http-push. Every push is the user's.
Changing where a remote points: git remote add/set-url, url.insteadOf, gh repo create/fork, repo visibility changes.
Publishing packages, images, or releases: npm/pnpm/yarn publish, docker push, gh release create/upload, cargo publish, and similar.
Running anything as root: sudo, doas, su, pkexec.

Changing Claude Code settings, hooks, or guardrails: ~/.claude/settings*.json, ~/.claude/hooks, ~/src/iamnande/dotfiles/guardrails, or the claude-guard source and its config, in any checkout or worktree.
